candidate.rollback: Remove the engine-owned response envelope adapter and retain the objective resolver state unchanged; no serving pointer is changed.

experiment.uncertainty_rule: Wilson 95% lower bound must exceed the historical baseline rate.

falsifier: Fewer than 20 eligible prospective episodes, success rate below 0.75, Wilson lower bound not above baseline, any critical identity regression, or independent-evaluator rejection.
mechanism: The objective resolver materializes transition, objective, cycle, relationship, language, next action, and clarification state; the model may author only the response text inside that immutable envelope.
statement: An engine-owned transition envelope with model-authored prose only will preserve workflow identity while retaining useful language generation.
